title: EzIce
description: this plugin makes the recipe's for ice easier
body:
makes ice crafting easier

### Packed Ice
![Packed Ice crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a95e71bfbd68a4fbf9ea3c7d9f155d52c46b689d.png)

You can craft 1 Packed Ice using only 1 normal Ice

### Blue Ice
![Blue Ice crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd75ac88069826702795f24d5069842d94eef97f.png)

You can craft 1 Blue Ice using only 1 Packed Ice

### Ice
![Ice crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/945eb37212641504cdfadb97fbfa4325940b0301.png)

You can craft 1 normal Ice using only 1 Blue ice
